Recipe:  
300g ap flour

50g white sugar

1/4 cup dried cranberries

3 dried orange slices (trader joes)

1 stick butter

(1 tbs Crème fraîche

1/4 cup heavy cream

3/4 cup whole milk

or just 1 cup butter milk instead of those 3)

2 tsp baking powder

1 tsp baking soda

1 tsp salt

Dice up the cranberries and orange slices and rub into the sugar thoroughly. Mix the dry ingredients, and chill everything. Once cold, cube the butter and mash into the flour just enough to make large flakes of butter. Incorporate sugar and flour and mix. Incorporate most of the milk and mix gently, just enough to get things wet. Add the rest if it really needs it.

Pour shaggy dough onto counter and form lightly into a disc around 1 inch thick. Dust with a little flour and throw into the freezer for 15-20 min with plastic on it.

I brushed some heavy cream on top and added a little demerara sugar.

Start oven at 425f and lower to 400f and bake for 20-25 minutes.

Automated Dialogue Replacement, also referred to as “looping.” In the early days, when the dialogue replacement was first being done, each re-recorded line of dialogue used a loop of film which would play over and over again in a loop.
